headline: TokenGate paper reports faster long-context prefill through learned token pruning
summary: A 2026-10-19 preprint introduces TokenGate, which learns to keep selected input tokens after an early model layer and adjusts upper-layer attention using the learned token scores. The authors report 1.4–11.3x lower time-to-first-token and 1.5–3.4x lower peak prefill memory than full-context Qwen3-1.7B at matched task accuracy across five task families. They also report a narrower Qwen3.5-2B hybrid-attention result. These are author-reported experiments: inference timing used batch size one on one A100, the linked code repository currently appears empty, and the research desk did not reproduce the results.
